summary.plain: The BCF detector at ADONE: scintillation counters and spark chambers, carefully calibrated for particle identification.
summary.technical: BCF detector: scintillation counters and spark chambers; the INFN-LNF page stresses its calibration for particle identification.

technology.quote: Particular care had been paid to the calibration of the detectors, in order to guarantee a good particle identification by a system scintillation counters and spark chambers.
